why: ARES lists Credo Ventures a.s. (IC 28538137, Karlovo namesti, Prague, est. 2009), the Prague management company of the Credo Ventures VC firm founded by Habermann and Bartos.
CzechCrunch dated 6 Oct 2022 says J&T Ventures and Credo Ventures took part in the Talkbase round.
Nordic9 (3 Nov 2024) reports Upheal's $10M Series A led by Headline with Credo Ventures and Kaya Ventures joining.
AIN (23 Jan 2025) reports Axoflow's round led by EBRD VC with existing investors Credo Ventures and e2vc increasing their stakes.

Funds I-IV (18M, 53M, ~100M, 75M EUR; fund IV reported closed Oct 2022) and Credo Stage 5 ($88M, reported as raised in a single closing, Mar 2026) are all actual raises of Credo; sum of about 325M EUR is plausible and no missing fund changes it by more than 20%.
Credo took part in Talkbase's round reported 6 Oct 2022 (CzechCrunch, and the 1 Nov 2022 cc.cz fund article also says Talkbase raised over $2M from J&T Ventures and Credo Ventures).
Raising.fi (25 Jun 2026) states the SuperPlane pre-seed round was led by Credo Ventures.
Same sum as I04: fund IV (75M EUR, closed per AIN 11 Oct 2022), fund III/II/I per cc.cz and Credo Stage 5 $88M closed per TNW; all actual raises of Credo and no big fund missing.
Upheal's pre-seed (about $1.05M, reported 19-20 Oct 2022) was led by KAYA VC with Credo Ventures participating.
TheSaaSNews: SuperPlane $2.28M pre-seed announced 24 Jun 2026, led by Credo Ventures.
ARES lists DEPO VENTURES, s.r.o. (IC 04753101, Plynarni 1617/10 Prague 7, est. 26 Jan 2016), matching DEPO Ventures (founded 2016, Plynarni 10 Prague).
Tech.eu (28 Apr 2025) lists existing backer DEPO Ventures in Kardi AI's $1.1M round.

Sum covers only angel funds I (35M CZK) and II (55M CZK) ~3.7M EUR, but DEPO states 9M EUR capital deployed and has a later closed Fund III/DEPO Ventures One (target 20M EUR, lead in ArcSpace) missing, so the total is understated by far more than 20%.
Startupcentrum (1 Sep 2026) says ArcSpace's round was led by DEPO Ventures through its DEPO Ventures One fund.
ARES lists Biotech Investments s.r.o. (IC 10885978, Praha 8, est. 2021) and inibio.eu names Biotech Investments, s.r.o. as the Investment Adviser of i&i Biotech Fund I SCSp.
The fund's own press-release boilerplate (17 Nov 2025) states that i&i Biotech Fund SCSp manages 53 million EUR, a stated AUM.
HealthCapital (24 May 2024) reports Captain T Cell's 8.5M EUR seed announced 22 May 2024 with i&i Biotech Fund I SCSp in the syndicate.
ARES lists Inven Capital, SICAV, a.s. (IC 02059533, est. 2013) and invencapital.cz names this exact entity as the fund vehicle of Inven Capital.
Inven Capital's website states it invests EUR 500m and cites total committed capital of 500 million EUR (stated figure).
AIN (11 Mar 2025) reports Vytal's round led by Inven Capital with NRW.Venture, which fits March 2025.
Same AIN article of 11 Mar 2025: Inven Capital co-led Vytal's round.
Andercore's company profile states the 40M round closed in Feb 2026 with Inven Capital joining as a new investor (press release 11 Feb 2026).
Deutsche Startups (12 Feb 2026) names Czech ClimateTech investor Inven Capital among those investing $40M in Andercore.
